ruleDefinitions.name: Abusing Print Executable
ruleDefinitions.description: Attackers can use print.exe for remote file copy

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\print\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("^print") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/D.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*print\\\.exe.*"))
